concerns.text: Task T012 promises to generate `docs/recruitment_protocol.md` (FR-009) but is marked `[ ]` (incomplete). The spec requires this document for the pre-study pilot check. Without this task completion, FR-009 cannot be satisfied.
Task T012.1 promises to generate `docs/recruitment_script_template.md` (FR-009) but is marked `[ ]` (incomplete). This is a required deliverable for the recruitment workflow defined in the plan.

Task T008.1 (Reproducibility Manifest Generator) is marked `[ ]` (incomplete). This task is critical for Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and Plan Phase 0 Step 6. Its absence leaves the project without a verified reproducibility record.

Task T006.2 (Recruitment Interface Stub) is marked `[ ]` (incomplete). This task is required to generate `docs/recruitment_workflow.md` (FR-001), which links real humans to IDs. The plan explicitly lists this as a dependency for the pilot check.

Task T053 is marked `[X]` (complete) but the artifact `results/quality_report.md` it promises to generate is not listed in the project structure or referenced as an input for downstream tasks like T040. This creates a gap in the data quality transparency required by the spec.
Task T012.1 depends on T012, which is currently incomplete. The dependency chain for recruitment documentation is broken, preventing the generation of the recruitment script template.
